subject: general
question: Biodegradable plastics are the new industry for export as well as marketing. Some advantages of these plastics are mentioned below. Which option is NOT an advantage?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Cannot be composted__****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​**Biodegradable plastics can **decompose naturally **in the environment, giving an end product that is **less harmful **and can also be easily **recycled **through an organic process.
 
• **​**Biodegradable plastics **consume less energy **during their manufacture, even though their production requires **more investment**. Hence, reduction of **environmental pollution**.
 
• Biodegradable plastics **break down easily** and can be absorbed by the soil or converted into compost. Even if a complete breakdown does not occur, it helps in achieving a **reduction **in the amount of space required to dispose of plastic waste.
 
• Biodegradable plastics lessen the amount of **greenhouse gas **emissions. Their decomposition does not release harmful products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There is a **risk of contamination **as the crops are typically sprayed with pesticides and can easily be transferred or included in the end product.
 
• There is a need for **costly equipment**, industrial processors, and composters.
 
• Some biodegradable plastics may produce methane when decomposing in landfills, it can **accelerate climate change**.
 
• Biodegradable Plastics need to be disposed of in very particular methods and **require water **to decompose properly, to ensure **proper and timely **decomposition.

1b
